content: {"episode_id":"ep-05070","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"Cornerstone United denied CPT 93271 (Cardiac Event Monitoring) under Reason Code CO-97 as bundled and not separately payable. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91). Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73), the note states that prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring is indicated to evaluate for arrhythmia burden and guide anticoagulation management. We request reconsideration of the CO-97 determination on this basis, with an outstanding balance of 297.4 on episode ep-05070."}
